plan: A half-dragon who turns into a dragon to burn and knock back her enemies.
aSurveiller: Her R (Dragon's Descent). She transforms and knocks back enemies in her path: step out of her way.
contrer: Step out of the way of her R: she knocks you towards her team.
Avoid her E in dragon form: it leaves a burning zone.
Slow her: she relies on her speed.

sorts.R: Turns into a dragon and knocks back.

momentFort: Clears very fast and rarely ganks before level 6. Invade her early: she struggles to defend herself at the start.
